Deseables •    Certificaciones como CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Fortinet FCA / FCP – Network Security, Microsoft AZ-900 / MS-900 o ITIL 4 Foundation. •    Experiencia con plataformas RMM y PSA (Datto RMM, Autotask u otras). •    Experiencia con Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure o AWS a nivel administrativo. •    Conocimientos de respaldos (Veeam) y virtualización (VMware o Hyper-V). •    Scripting en PowerShell, Python o Bash para automatizar tareas repetitivas. Si tienes certificaciones, inclúyelas en las últimas páginas de tu CV y envía todo en un solo archivo PDF . Beneficios •    Contrato permanente con todas las prestaciones de ley (IHSS, RAP, décimo tercer y décimo cuarto mes, vacaciones según antigüedad). •    Salario competitivo acorde a la experiencia. •    Formación y apoyo para certificaciones de fabricantes con los que GLADiiUM es partner (Fortinet, Sophos, Microsoft, Cloudflare, entre otros). •    Ruta de crecimiento hacia NOC Nivel 2 y especializaciones en SOC, nube o ingeniería de redes. •    Experiencia práctica con plataformas empresariales de red, seguridad y nube en entornos reales de múltiples clientes. •    Exposición a operaciones en varios países, junto a un equipo regional en Honduras, Puerto Rico y España. •    Equipo de trabajo proporcionado por la empresa y un ambiente colaborativo dentro del NSOC. review_candidates.description: Classification Title Systems Admin/Programmer III Classification Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in an appropriate area and two years of relevant experience; or a high school diploma or equivalent and six years of experience. Appropriate college coursework or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate for the required experience. Job Description UF Information Technology (UFIT) is currently seeking an intermediate-level Storage Administrator III to join Infrastructure and Communication Technology (ICT), Storage Platforms, a unit within UFIT. This role serves as a core technical contributor for enterprise storage and data protection infrastructure systems. You will provide intermediate-level administration, maintenance, and operational support for complex enterprise storage and backup environments, ensuring the performance, reliability, and recoverability of critical university data. As an integral team member, you will execute system implementations, troubleshoot operational escalations, and collaborate with senior engineers on infrastructure upgrades and technical projects. UF Information Technology (UFIT) enables teaching, learning, research, and service on campus and across the region with state-of-the-art enterprise IT systems, including SEC and SUS universities, and the opportunity to teach using HiPerGator. Infrastructure and Communication Technology (ICT) is a division of UF Information Technology that manages the UF Data Center and delivers hosted server, storage, virtualization, database, email, and related systems, in addition to connecting the University of Florida campuses to the world via high-speed data, video, Wi-Fi, telecommunications, and VoIP services. The Storage Platforms team is responsible for the configuration, administration, and support of UFIT’s core enterprise storage and data protection infrastructure. They deploy and maintain critical data services, managing enterprise SAN/NAS arrays, storage networking, disaster recovery platforms, and enterprise backup systems such as Cohesity, Rubrik, and IBM Spectrum Protect. Some Key Responsibilities And Characteristics Of This Position Are Systems Administration & Operations (40%): Provide core administration of enterprise storage and backup systems. Install, configure, patch, and maintain storage arrays, backup solutions, and associated server environments (Linux/Windows) in accordance with established UFIT baselines and change management processes. Project Support & Implementation (20%): Participate in departmental and cross-functional technical projects. Assist senior staff in testing, configuring, and deploying new infrastructure solutions, hardware rollouts, and lead minor system upgrades as directed. Incident Escalation & Troubleshooting (15%): Diagnose, isolate, and resolve intermediate-to-complex hardware, storage networking, and software issues escalated beyond Tier 1/2 support. Coordinate with vendors for support ticket resolution and participate in the off-hours on-call rotation. Documentation & Technical Reporting (15%): Maintain accurate, up-to-date technical documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, system inventories, and troubleshooting guides. Assist in collecting system utilization metrics for capacity reporting and planning. Professional Development & Team Support (10%): Stay current with emerging storage and backup technologies, test new operational tools in non-production environments, and actively participate in team knowledge sharing to improve overall unit efficiency. About UF Information Technology Led by Senior Vice President and CIO Elias Eldayrie, the nine departments comprising UFIT are: Academic Technology; AI² Center; Applications, Development, and Integrations; Business Center; Customer Experience and Resource Planning; Data Platform and Analytics; Information Security Office; Infrastructure and Communication Technology; and Research Computing. UF Information Technology (UFIT) enables teaching, learning, research, and service on campus and across the region with state-of-the-art enterprise IT systems, including SEC and SUS universities, and the opportunity to teach using HiPerGator. For more information about UFIT and its goals and governance, visit https://it.ufl.edu/about-ufit/strategic-plan/. About The University Of Florida One of America’s all-around best universities, the University of Florida drives future-making education, eye-opening discoveries, life-saving health care, and community-building collaboration for our state, our nation, and our world. UF is in Gainesville, a city of approximately 150,000 residents in North-Central Florida, 50 miles from Florida’s West Coast, 67 miles from the Atlantic Ocean, and within a 2-hour drive to large metropolitan areas (Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville). The beautiful climate and extensive nearby parks and recreational areas afford year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, biking, and nature photography. UF’s large college sports programs, museums, and performing arts center support various activities and cultural events for residents to enjoy. Learn more about what Gainesville has to offer at Visit Gainesville. Exceptional Benefits UF provides various leave programs based on an employee’s salary plan, including vacation, sick leave, holidays, personal leave days, and paid family leave. In addition to paid time off, the University of Florida offers a very competitive benefits package. Expected Salary $85,000 - $95,000; Commensurate with education and experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in an appropriate area and two years of relevant experience; or a high school diploma or equivalent and six years of experience. Appropriate college coursework or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate for the required experience. Preferred The ideal candidate will possess the following education, experience, and skills: EDUCATION & TRAINING Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of relevant IT experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience (such as an Associate degree and four (4) years of experience, or a high school diploma and six (6) years of experience). Experience Hands-on experience (2–4 years) in Linux (RHEL) and/or Windows Server administration. Practical experience managing enterprise storage systems, including SAN/NAS platforms, fiber channel, zoning, and LUN allocation. Experience configuring and supporting enterprise backup and recovery solutions (e.g., Cohesity, Rubrik, IBM Spectrum Protect/TSM). Working experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware) and directory services (Active Directory, LDAP). Skills Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical peers and campus stakeholders. Strong troubleshooting skills and attention to detail, particularly in maintaining accurate system documentation and operational runbooks. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python for systems administration and task automation. KNOWLEDGE Working knowledge of networking essentials, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, and basic routing. Familiarity with ITIL and IT Service Management (ITSM) workflows, specifically Incident, Change, and Problem management processes. Knowledge of infrastructure monitoring and alerting applications (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix, or equivalent). Abilities Ability to participate as an active team member on technical projects and execute implementation steps according to project plans. Ability to prioritize workloads, manage operational tickets, and multitask effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused production environment. Think practically to solve operational issues using defined technical procedures and suggest workflow improvements for day-to-day tasks. Special Instructions To Applicants Work visa sponsorship is not available for this position. This is not a remote work position and is located in Gainesville, FL. A Level 2 Criminal Background Screening Is Required. Applicants are required to submit the following with their application: Cover Letter Resume List of professional references with contact information (Minimum of 3, with one from a previous or current supervisor) Application must be submitted by 11:55 p.m. (ET) of the posting end date. Health Assessment Required: No
